published_commit_binding: The publishing owner will record any tree-equivalent durable commit mapping. This review makes no claim that the local commit ID is currently a GitHub commit.
method: Manual comparison of each expected fact with the canonical answer content and its designated implementation sources; this is semantic source review, independent of lexical retrieval ranking.

facts.expected_fact: SAT and polygon clipping intersect full native unit squares with one coherent rotated rectangle union; AABBs only bound traversal.
facts.source_assessment: Native SAT/clipping and adapter traversal use whole unit squares against coherent rotated proxy rectangles; AABBs only enumerate possible cells. Canonical documentation discloses the small-area and short-segment numerical filters.

facts.expected_fact: Six proxies and two holes remain; exact exterior source-grid runs remove partial sibling seams.
facts.source_assessment: Exact source-grid exterior runs subtract partial sibling coverage before rotation. Canonical fixture retains its six disjoint proxy rectangles and two holes.

facts.expected_fact: All nonempty material contributes geometry but only supported ambient Sand supplies the new response.
facts.source_assessment: The adapter accumulates nonempty-material overlap before restricting response segments to ambient Sand with resident native support; Water/hot/unsupported material supplies no new response.

facts.expected_fact: The pure planner uses current contact-point velocity, mass and inertia for a zero-restitution unilateral normal impulse.
facts.source_assessment: The pure planner uses v plus omega cross r, inverse effective mass 1/M plus (r cross n)^2/I, and a unilateral zero-restitution normal impulse.

facts.expected_fact: Only currently approaching parallel segments enter the length-weighted resultant, recomputed on each of four fixed sweeps.
facts.source_assessment: On each of four fixed sweeps, only then-approaching members contribute to each parallel group resultant, weighted by exterior-segment length.

facts.expected_fact: Each planned impulse must satisfy the registered energy bound; actual Rapier energy is checked separately, with no full multi-contact convergence claim.
facts.source_assessment: The planner checks per-impulse energy nonincrease within its 1e-8 bound. The bridge independently validates actual finite readback and the 1e-4 bound. Residual approach remains reported; no convergence claim follows.

facts.expected_fact: The worker freezes copied observations before publication; main never queries live native cells.
facts.source_assessment: The specialized worker copies and recursively freezes observations into its immutable snapshot; the main contact-response path consumes the snapshot rather than querying native cells.

facts.expected_fact: Snapshot, tick, exact revision, epoch, token, generation and forward sample order are checked before candidate RID mutation.
facts.source_assessment: The bridge checks exact publication/session identities and modular forward sample order before any candidate RID mutation, then consumes the replay lease before applying impulses.

facts.expected_fact: Sample age over one, corner drift over 0.25 cells, malformed or incomplete geometry and duplicate observations refuse.
facts.source_assessment: Age above one, excessive corner drift, malformed/incomplete geometry and duplicate or old publications are preflight refusals. The newly repaired post-impulse readback failure is separately terminal, retains the consumed lease and is not represented as a harmless refusal.

facts.expected_fact: V resets and toggles the candidate; --sand-resistance enables it at launch. Without the flag the prior response remains selected.
facts.source_assessment: Lab KEY_V toggles the candidate and resets the session; the command-line flag enables it, while omission leaves the prior response selected.

facts.expected_fact: The lab observes both arms, while session resistance defaults to false.
facts.source_assessment: The lab passes measure_contacts=true for both arms; the session sand_resistance parameter and stored state default to false.

facts.expected_fact: The 11/9 interface, conservative material transactions, Water, chemistry, hard-contact and ordinary GCR defaults remain; Y1 #343 is not promoted.
facts.source_assessment: The contact channel is separate from the unchanged packed 11/9 ABI and existing conservative transfers. Native material/Water/hard-contact policies and ordinary GCR defaults are untouched; canonical policy leaves Y1 #343 unpromoted.

facts.expected_fact: Area-samples and overlap-cell-samples count complete consumed native observations, not native simulation ticks.
facts.source_assessment: Session totals accumulate overlap only for complete consumed observations. The analyzer divides geometric totals by that observation count and labels asynchronous samples distinctly from native ticks.

facts.expected_fact: Total owner observation/freeze and main response CPU includes refused attempts and unconsumed publications; the proposed mean divides by complete consumed geometry observations.
facts.source_assessment: Worker cumulative timing covers observation/freeze attempts including unconsumed publications; main timing is charged before response disposition. The analyzer divides their sum by complete consumed observations, with separate denominators for worker, Rapier, synchronization and latency.

facts.expected_fact: Repeated live trajectories have ranges but are not matched causal comparisons; headless CPU measurements do not establish GPU or human acceptance.
facts.source_assessment: Canonical documentation and analyzer interpretation explicitly limit independent live repeats to descriptive ranges, and distinguish headless CPU evidence from GPU/human gameplay acceptance.

facts.expected_fact: Deeply embedded cells without an exterior face crossing can retain overlap without a response segment.
facts.source_assessment: The adapter can count positive whole-cell overlap without a crossing exterior support segment when deeply embedded; the canonical contract states this limitation.

facts.expected_fact: The candidate adds no position correction, cell mutation or automatic restoration; sleeping remains aggregate ownership.
facts.source_assessment: The candidate adds impulses only: it introduces no position correction, material-cell mutation or restoration transition. Existing lifecycle documentation retains aggregate ownership while sleeping.

facts.expected_fact: Dense-contact, lifecycle, source-qualified platform and human gameplay gates remain separate; #347 stays draft and #281/#12 remain open.
facts.source_assessment: Canonical qualification keeps dense-contact, lifecycle, source-qualified platform and human acceptance separate. Independent GitHub reads on 2026-11-03T23:54:31Z confirmed #347 open draft/unmerged and #281/#12 open.

qualification_scope: No new runtime, physical, target-platform, GPU, lifecycle or human acceptance is established by this semantic review. The successor hosted matrix must qualify its exact executed source independently.
ledger_review: The current takeover and dense-contact ledgers distinguish original qualified source from pending repaired-source qualification, retain unresolved physical/lifecycle limits, and now state the contact numerator and denominator correctly. No further concrete factual gap found.
